config_snapshot:
# Small-model performance benchmark; use with benchmark_training.py --config.
# Keeps phase 0d, observation/history, and PPO settings from config.yaml.
# Explicit differences: [64, 64] network, fresh policy, one environment,
# and a 1,024-sample batch. CLI flags control the measured run duration.
settings:
  game_id: warehouse_brawl
  action_space: discrete

folders:
  parent_dir: ./baselines/small-model-training
  model_name: ppo_small_mlp

curriculum:
  phase: "0d"

phases:
  "0d":
    name: Full Stage Navigation
    description: Navigate to multiple targets anywhere on stage
    type: navigation
    navigation:
      min_dist: 1.0
      max_dist: 15.0
      fall_penalty: -30.0
      time_limit_seconds: 60
      multi_target: 3
    opponents:
      constant_agent: 1.0

policy_kwargs:
  net_arch: [64, 64]

frame_stack: 4

ppo_settings:
  gamma: 0.99
  gae_lambda: 0.95
  learning_rate: [3.0e-4, 1.0e-6]
  clip_range: [0.2, 0.05]
  ent_coef: 0.01
  nav_ent_coef: 0.05
  batch_size: 1024
  n_epochs: 8
  n_steps: 1024
  vf_coef: 0.5
  max_grad_norm: 0.5
  time_steps: 5000000
  model_checkpoint: "0"

environment_settings:
  max_timesteps: 5400
  render_mode: null
  resolution: LOW
  n_envs: 1

opponent_history:
  enabled: true
  history_length: 60
  action_dim: 10
